summary: Pruned 8 finished rows (Inky Pathways run ended 1 Jul, plus 1-3 Jul one-offs: Lost at Sea, Babes & Tots and Friendship Lunch instances, Jazz Fridays 3 Jul, Carolina Cury in-store, Swift Walk, Tolworth Rewilding Day). Added 29 dated events and 5 recurring rows. The big win this run: surbitonpartnership.co.uk/events turns out to be a fetchable Tribe calendar with per-event pages (times, prices, addresses) - it yielded free St Andrew's market-morning concerts (17 Oct KGS, 21 Nov Hinchley Wood, 19 Dec Kingston Music Service), cornerHOUSE comedy (23 Oct McGhie/Campe, 27 Nov Ian Smith) and poetry (16 Oct), ExCellar blues (Stevie Watts 29 Oct), and Hymns & Pimms at Long Ditton (2 Aug). Bach to Baby's official Surbiton page gave the autumn/Christmas series (27 Oct, 24 Nov, 8 Dec). Summer-holiday family sweep via the (re-pathed) LibraryOn frontend added under-5s music/story sessions (Interactive Music 30 Jul, Uke & Play 4 Aug, Once Upon a Beat Kingston 6 Aug, Seaside Storytime 7 Aug) and confirmed the two held Once Upon a Beat rows; the NT Morden Hall page (fetchable this run!) added Park Explorers for Under 5s (6+13 Jul), Jungle Book outdoor theatre (21-22 Jul), National Meadows Day (4 Jul), the Osun River Festival (9 Aug) and confirmed the Harvest Festival time. Ram Jam/Grey Horse added 4 gigs (Never The Bride, Jan Echo triple bill, Dogs Hosting Fleas, samba night) and all 5 held gig rows were confirmed with times. Banquet church-venue shows added (JJerome87 13 Jul, Graham Coxon 24 Jul); Twickenham Choral with Onyx Brass at All Saints (11 Jul) and a second ExCellar gig (Will James 26 Nov, verify) round it out. 15 rows had verify flags cleared/details confirmed. The Lamb Instagram/Facebook wall stayed uncrackable (WeGotTickets/Bandsintown/Gigseekr/DICE all empty or blocked) - a Sunday Session recurring row now covers the stable pattern honestly.
